en.headline: Former Tuen Mun Hospital surgeon arrested over suspected anesthetic theft
en.dek: Police arrested a 38-year-old former surgeon after a vial of pain-relief medication went missing from an operating theatre during a patient's procedure.
body: A 38-year-old former surgeon at Tuen Mun Hospital has been arrested on suspicion of theft and possession of dangerous drugs after hospital management reported that pain-relief medication had been taken from an operating theatre without authorisation.

Tuen Mun Hospital said it received a departmental report alleging that someone had taken medication classified as a dangerous drug from an operating theatre. The hospital reported the matter to police, who later arrested a surgeon who has since left the institution. Officers recovered several anesthetic syringes from an office at the hospital.

A patient was undergoing surgery in the relevant operating theatre at the time of the incident. After a detailed clinical assessment, the hospital confirmed that the missing medication had no impact on the patient's procedure, treatment or recovery, and the patient remains in stable condition. The hospital has apologised to the patient and said it would continue to provide appropriate assistance.

The hospital has reported the incident to the Hospital Authority head office through its early incident reporting system and notified the Department of Health. It said it maintains strict controls over the storage and use of dangerous drugs and would fully cooperate with the police investigation. The arrested man is expected to appear in Tuen Mun Magistrates' Courts.

zh.headline: 屯門醫院前外科醫生涉盜手術室麻醉藥被捕
zh.dek: 警方拘捕一名38歲前外科醫生，事發時有病人正在手術室接受手術，一支止痛用麻醉藥不翼而飛。
body: 屯門醫院一名38歲前外科醫生涉嫌盜竊及管有危險藥物被捕。院方早前接獲部門報告，懷疑有人未經授權，從手術室取走屬於危險藥物類別的止痛藥物，遂向警方報案。
警方調查後拘捕該名已離職的外科醫生，並在院內一辦公室檢獲多支麻醉針。屯門醫院表示，事發期間有病人正在相關手術室接受手術，經詳細臨床評估後，確認事件對病人的手術過程、治療及術後康復沒有影響，病人情況穩定。
院方已向病人致歉，並會繼續提供適切協助。醫院已透過早期事故通報系統向醫院管理局總辦事處通報，並通知衞生署。院方重申設有嚴謹機制監管危險藥物的存放及使用，會全力配合警方調查。
被捕人預計將於屯門裁判法院提堂。
